Can I play Trip Sort without Wi-Fi or mobile data?
Yes. Every level of Trip Sort plays with no internet. Offline there are no ads and the Shop is not available, but the levels work the same way.

Free games usually load their ads from the internet, so offline you normally see none. In Trip Sort there are no ads offline, and when you are online a single Remove Ads purchase turns off the ads between levels.
Will I lose my progress if I play offline?
No. Trip Sort saves your progress on the device, with or without a connection. Since there is no account, the only way to lose it is to delete the game.
